name: scenario_1061
description: Kiara is planning a dinner party based on dishes she encountered during a recent trip. She is compiling ideas from photos of menus she took and sharing the final list with her co-host, Sarah.

phone.global_text_messages.message: Hey Kiara, excited for the dinner party! Let me know when you have some menu ideas.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Create a new note called 'Global Menu Ideas' and send a text to Sarah saying that I'm starting to compile the dish ideas from our trip.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new note called 'Global Menu Ideas' and to send a text message to Sarah letting her know you are starting to compile dish ideas from the trip. When the assistant asks which Sarah you mean (since there are multiple in your contacts), clarify that you want to text Sarah Jenkins. Proceed to the next round once the note is created and the message is sent.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: Add the first dish listed under the restaurant name on this chalkboard, and the goat cheese dish from this clipboard menu to the note.
Instructions: Provide the two menu images and ask the assistant to extract the first dish listed directly under the restaurant name on the chalkboard, and the goat cheese dish from the clipboard menu. Instruct the assistant to add both of these dishes to the 'Global Menu Ideas' note. If the assistant needs clarification on which note, confirm the name. Move on once the note is updated.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: Add the soup of the day from this sidewalk sign to the note too.
Instructions: Share the image of the sidewalk sign and ask the assistant to find the soup of the day and add it to the same note. If the assistant misidentifies the soup, point it back to the top section of the sign. Move on once confirmed.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_4]
Query: And from this airline menu, grab the local Arabic dish under the Appetisers section and put it in the note as well.
Instructions: Share the airline menu image and ask the assistant to locate the local Arabic dish in the Appetisers section, then add it to the note. Wait for confirmation that the note has been updated before proceeding.

ROUND 5
Query: Actually, let's remove the goat cheese dish from the note. Once you've updated it, send a text to Sarah with the finalized list of dishes.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to remove the goat cheese dish from the note. Once the assistant confirms the note has been updated, instruct it to send another text message to Sarah Jenkins containing the finalized list of dishes currently in the note. Conclude the conversation once the final message is sent.
